lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white blobs arranged in approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns along the mid-to-upper flank, posterior to the branchial region, with a decrease in spot diameter and increase in density towards the dorsal surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical pale bands intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating a recurring rectangular grid pattern across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible along the dorsal-lateral transition, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with specular highlights on the upper margin and shadowing on the lower margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, smooth-edged semi-circular indentation or traumatic loss of tissue is located on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
